title: HeaLSS Insight Tool: confidence versus competence in U.S. health literacy (HINTS 7 and PIAAC Cycle 2)
description: Python pipeline and harmonization codebook for comparing self-reported health-information confidence (HINTS 7, 2024) with directly measured adult literacy (PIAAC Cycle 2, 2023) in identically defined subgroups of U.S. adults aged 20 to 65, with an exploratory bridge to Medicaid enrollees through the ACS 2024 PUMS. No survey microdata are included.
